scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on her account and requesting a refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Guadalupe Rodriguez and I'm 30. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Okay, I see. Can you tell me your full name and age again so I can pull up the account?
I just said that, it's Guadalupe Rodriguez and I'm 30.
Right, okay. I'm looking at the transaction now. It says it's from 'Global Tech Services'. Does that sound familiar at all?
No, I've never heard of them. I haven't bought anything from a tech company recently.
Look, I can't really tell you more about the merchant. Since you don't recognize it, I'm just going to go ahead and escalate this to our fraud department. They handle these things.
Wait, can't you just refund it now? It's only $76.
That's just our policy. I don't have the authority to issue refunds for unrecognized charges without a fraud review. You'll hear from them in 3-5 business days.

escalation_reason: Agent claimed lack of authority to resolve simple unrecognized transaction and deferred to fraud department without attempting basic verification or merchant lookup.

judge_scores.justification: The agent asked the customer to repeat information already provided in the opening message and failed to perform any meaningful verification before immediately escalating. Furthermore, the agent took no concrete action within their authority and vaguely referenced policy rather than clearly explaining the standard procedure.
